description: Cloud AFK auto-fishing and auto-mining (services/cloud-afk/README.md, 'Auto-fishing and auto-mining'). settings: the new keys of the features group with their defaults and ranges, the fixed rules (miningBlocks in their order; keep 1-100; idle.every 20-3600 s; yaw -180..180, pitch -90..90), the defaults a saved setting's missing parts take, the live socket's numbers and the autores codes with the auto_off reasons. config: a fishing or mining value of an account PATCH's config (carried whole) and either its stored form (every part there: missing optional parts take their defaults; blocks null means all of miningBlocks) or the first problem in document order, {code: invalid_config, field, reason: unknown | type | missing | range} or {code: invalid_command, field, reason} for full.command (the text rule's reasons, or secret for a login/register/password command); blocks must be 1-33 distinct ids of miningBlocks in its order. shape: an operation as a client sends it in {"t":"auto","acct","id","op"} and the problem (null: well-formed; else autores invalid {reason, field?}): pause and resume name a mode; aim names yaw and pitch, finite numbers within their ranges. view: Account.features.fishing | .mining {mode, on, slot, limited} from the switch (service), the machine's capability (caps), the setting (enabled), the public reason of the first mode limit matching the account's server for the mode (limited, or null) and the slot counts; limited and slot only while mode is on, slot only while on is false and nothing limits. limits: per mode the id of the first entry (in the list's order, the oldest first) that names the mode and matches the server (host as stored; resolved: the addresses afk-host resolved before connecting, [] for the Worker), matching as the block list does: a domain entry its own name, every subdomain and its resolved ips; an ip entry its address or network. slots: the Worker's check when a PATCH turns a mode on: invalid_config {field: <mode>.enabled, reason: off | limited}, then limit_fishing | limit_mining {scope: player | host, max}, the player's limit first; mining's machine count is the terrain slots (movementSlotsPerHost: the machine's other accounts with movement or mining on) and does not apply while the account's own movement holds its slot (holdsTerrain). Generated by generate-auto-op-v1.mjs; do not edit by hand.
